positions.description: Skills: Android Development · C++ · Data Analysis · A/B Testing · Advertising · Front-End Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Nudj Health - Sr. Software Engineer, May 2021 - Nov. 2021
    ◦ Developed a dashboard for healthcare professionals using TypeScript, React, Material UI and NextJS to allow users to support patients throughout the entire lifecycle of care from onboarding, to logging visits, health assessments, and more
    ◦ Maintained and contributed to backend using TypeScript, Node, and GraphQL to securely retrieve patient data while adhering to strict HIPAA compliance regulations
    ◦ Implemented an end-to-end testing solution leveraging Cypress/Jest and Storybook to add documentation to be used by non-technical designers and engineers alike

Fox Networks Group - Software Engineer, Oct. 2017 - May 2021
    ◦ Extensively utilized React/Redux and SASS to implement a highly responsive/browser compatible web platform for major media sites such as Fox, Fox Nation, Fox Sports, FX, and National Geographic
    ◦ Owned the end-to-end integration of analytics services such as Tealium and Segment
    ◦  Worked closely with marketing and design teams to spearhead A/B testing using Optimizely and custom React components
positions.insights: Skills: Next.js · TypeScript · A/B Testing · GraphQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Implemented a user facing, responsive, server-side rendered React/Sass front end
•  Using Redux and Redux Sagas heavily optimized the server-side rendering process to improve user experience by significantly reducing load time
•  Built and maintained custom endpoints using Express and GraphQL

positions.title: Software Engineering TA
positions.description:
• Worked one on one with students reviewing fundamental JavaScript concepts such as recursion, data structures, promises, and others
• Proctored 100+ technical interviews and mock interviews for prospective students and alumni
• Provided mentorship to engineering teams through code review, debugging, and architecture design

positions.title: Neuropsychology Technician
positions.description:
• Collaborated in standardizing the FCI-SF, a subtest of the ADNI-3 which is a nationwide longitudinal study focused on investigating brain and fluid biomarkers of alzheimer's disease
• Assisted in various neuropsychological research studies, wrote literature reviews, and aiding in interpreting testing results
• Tested over 300+ patients using multiple neuropsychological batteries, including drug research studies

company.name: The University of Alabama at Birmingham

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Performed statistical analysis using SPSS
• Developed macros in Visual Basic to streamline data collection from proprietary eye-tracking devices to easily import into other software programs for analysis
• Performed multiple research studies on children and young adults in local elementary schools and on campus

volunteerExperiences.description:

 ◦ Provided one-on-one support to help cultivate interest in potential jobs in software development and tech related positions
